lines.zh: 我两条腿走路，身体前倾。
lines.en: I walk on two legs, leaning forward.

lines.zh: 尾巴在后面拖着，帮我平衡。
lines.en: My tail trails behind, balancing me.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸的悬崖边走。
lines.en: I walk the riverbank's cliff edge.
I cross a clearing in the wood.
Short steps, but sure.
I stop and look up at the trees.
I turn into the redwood grove.
I keep my head down, foraging as I go.

lines.zh: 我听到声音，加快了脚步。
lines.en: I hear something and quicken my pace.
I duck under a fallen trunk.
I walk close along the riverbank ferns.
I hop a shallow ditch.
I walk into the hardwood shade.
I turn toward the sound of water.
I stand and turn my head this way and that.
My tail brushes the ground.
I hear movement in the trees.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着嘴里的嫩叶。
lines.en: I chew the tender leaves in my mouth.
I nibble a tender leaf and chew a long time.
Sun leaks through the canopy.
I'm watchful; I can't sleep soundly.
I tilt my head to the wind.
There's a young one's scent nearby.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听草里的动静。
lines.en: Head tilted, I listen to the grass.
I take another small bite.
I raise my head, eyes wide.
Your shadow startled me.

lines.zh: 我两条腿走路，身体前倾着看你。
lines.en: I walk on two legs, leaning toward you.
You're not a tree.
My forelimbs are held to my chest.
Come closer and I'll run.
I come here often.
I relax a little.

lines.zh: 红杉林里，草一动我就叫。
lines.en: In the redwoods, one stir of grass makes me cry out.
In Hell Creek, I scare easily.
That grazed my shoulder.
I hide behind a tree.
I am quick on my feet, but no fighter.
I can still stand; come again.
I need to get away from here.
Fifteen health does not survive two blows.
Those shoots look tender.

lines.zh: 你举着的，是纤维植物吧。
lines.en: Is that fibrous plant you're holding?
I edge toward that patch of young leaves.
I bite and chew slowly.
It's a little bitter.
I'll spit out the fibre when I'm done.
Don't come near my back.
The fibres are coarse, but I am hungry.
I lower my head and keep eating.
A little more.
You bump me and I jump.
I dive headfirst into the ferns.
I shake my legs.
That nearly knocked me over.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，尾巴撑住了。
lines.en: I tip, and my tail catches me.
Don't come at me suddenly.
I carry on along the bank.
Do not crowd me; I startle easily.
A kin is calling in the wood.
I follow the call.
It stands by a fallen log.
Then we forage apart.
This wood is big enough for both.
The young will follow.
I must stay alert.

lines.zh: 我继续走，纤维植物嚼在嘴里。
lines.en: I keep walking, fiber plants in my mouth.
I take a tender leaf.
I pin it with a forelimb.
This is stringy.
I spit out the fibre.
I keep it at the side of my mouth.
The taste is average.
I chew as I walk.
This leaf chews just right.
A sound in the trees.
I call the young to my side.
It's behind a tree.
I'm not sure what it is.
Look first, then decide.
I retreat into the brush.
Neither have I.
It turns first.
I see it; I crouch down first.
I edge along the brush.
I crouch and edge toward the ferns.
I check the young behind me.
It isn't following.
I slow to a stop.
The wood is quiet again.
I go back to foraging.
My legs are still shaking.
I breathe deep.
It's all right now.
My teeth sink in, but not deep.
I ram, then run.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，只想推开你。
lines.en: It's light; I only want to push you off.
My claws are good for digging, nothing more.
My legs are trembling.
Back behind the tree, hide a moment.
I watch you, panting.
I kick you once, very lightly.
I need to get back to the young.
I rake with a forelimb.
I duck and butt back.
The riverbank ferns are just tall enough to hide me.
I test the leaf litter.
The riverbank is over there.
I walk over and look at the water.
Nothing stirs in the water.
I turn back into the wood.
There are plenty of tender leaves.
I eat a few bites.
The riverbank grass is thicker over there.
I'm careful on the way.
This wood will do.

lines.zh: 我嚼的纤维，能吐出来给你。
lines.en: The fiber I chew, I can spit out for you.

lines.zh: 火燎到我，我拼命往河边跑。
lines.en: Fire catches me and I run for the river.

lines.zh: 我从崖上摔下去，腿弯了。
lines.en: I fall from the cliff and my leg bends wrong.
Water covers my head; I kick wildly.
The blast throws me into the brush.
An arrow bites my tail.
Light leaves me dizzy and unsteady.

lines.zh: 饿得我连叶子都嚼不动。
lines.en: Too hungry to chew even leaves.
